bullets.title: Rebirth: A Fable of Love, Forgiveness, and Following Your Heart
bullets.note:
This is the debut novel of [Kamal
Ravikant](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dK2&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=U&),
my friend who convinced me to take a “startup vacation” and keep writing. He
changed my life. I’m loving this fast read, and it makes me want to
immediately escape on a global walkabout or journey through the Camino de
Santiago path in Spain. If you need an injection of wanderlust, this is your
medicine. Here’s the description: “After the death of his estranged father,
Amit takes his parent's ashes to the Ganges to fulfill a deathbed promise.
Instead of returning home, he wanders, his pain and grief leaving him confused
about his future. Almost broke, unsure about his direction in life, and
running from memories, he is led by fate to the Camino de Santiago, an ancient
550-mile pilgrimage route across northern Spain.”

bullets.title: Thera-Zinc Spray
bullets.note:
,
peppermint clove flavor. I use this 2-4x per day during a full day of travel,
along with 1g of vitamin C every 1-2 hours. It’s cheap insurance for immune
support when surrounded by coughing, sneezing, and phlegm-spraying bipeds.

bullets.title: Freo Slant Board
bullets.note:
This was introduced to me by an ultra-endurance runner. It appears to directly
address the foot, arch, and ankle issues that have caused leg and hip problems
in the past. It’s still too early to say with 100% confidence, but I can say
this: START SLOW. Do NOT do more than 20 seconds in each position to start, or
you will suffer. Trust me on this.
